description: List labeled rooms/zones on a floorplan. Each region has a polygon (normalized 0-1 coordinates), an optional location_id linking to the Locations hierarchy, and a "reviewed" flag for AI-detected regions.

location_id.description: Filter regions linked to a specific location

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_floorplan_regions
title: List floorplan regions
